task.name: 0/1 knapsack
task.description: Write a select_next_item(remaining_capacity, remaining_weights, remaining_values) Python heuristic that picks the next item to add, or -1 to stop, while building 0/1 knapsack solutions; scored by mean total value on eight generated 100-item instances with capacity 12.5 (higher is better).
task.contract: select_next_item(remaining_capacity, remaining_weights, remaining_values) -> index into the remaining (feasible) arrays, or -1 to stop. Score: mean total value
